name: SMA Crossover — Commodity Futures (50/200)
description: Trend-following SMA crossover strategy across 5 commodity futures (Crude Oil, Gold, Silver, Natural Gas, Copper). Enters long on a golden cross (50-day SMA crosses above 200-day SMA) and exits on a death cross (50-day crosses below 200-day). Equal weight allocation is applied across all active positions. Uses backward Panama Canal adjustment with first-of-month rollover for continuous price series.
source:
# SMA Crossover Strategy — Commodity Futures (50/200)
# Universe: CL (Crude Oil), GC (Gold), SI (Silver), NG (Natural Gas), HG (Copper)
#
# RULES:
# - Entry (Long):  Golden cross — 50-day SMA crosses ABOVE 200-day SMA
# - Exit  (Long):  Death cross  — 50-day SMA crosses BELOW 200-day SMA
# - Sizing:        Equal weight (1/N) across all active long positions
# - Futures:       Backward Panama Canal adjustment, first-of-month rollover

# --- Data Loading ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()

# Build continuous futures price series
cont = futures_continuation(
    timeframe=1D,
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardPanamaCanal
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c

# --- Moving Averages ---
fast_sma = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
slow_sma = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# --- Crossover Signals ---
# Golden cross: fast SMA crosses above slow SMA → enter long
golden_cross = crossover(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# Death cross: fast SMA crosses below slow SMA → exit long
death_cross = crossunder(fast_sma, slow_sma)

# Hold position continuously between entry and exit signals
held = hold_until()(enter=golden_cross, exit=death_cross)

# --- Position Sizing ---
# Equal weight (1/N) across all assets currently holding a long position
weights = equal_weight()(active_mask=held)

# --- Execution ---
# Wire front contract symbol for futures rollover detection
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)

# Zone-based execution: long entries and exits
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)

# Allocate equal share of equity to each active position
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights.weight * 100)
